def transform(grid):
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if seen[i][j] or grid[i][j]==8: continue
            # flood fill the zero/colored region (connected non-8 component)
            stack=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
            seen[i][j]=True
            color=grid[i][j]
            while stack:
                r,c=stack.pop(); cells.append((r,c))
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc]!=8:
                        seen[nr][nc]=True; stack.append((nr,nc))
            cols={v for _,v in cells}
            if len(cols)!=1 or 0 not in cols: continue  # pure zero region
            # non-zero motif cells inside region
            nz=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if grid[r][c]!=0]
            if not nz: continue
            r0=min(r for r,_ in nz); r1=max(r for r,_ in nz)
            c0=min(c for _,c in nz); c1=max(c for _,c in nz)
            pat=[[grid[r0+a][c0+b] for b in range(c1-c0+1)] for a in range(r1-r0+1)]

            rmin=min(r for r,_ in cells); rmax=max(r for r,_ in cells)
            cmin=min(c for _,c in cells); cmax=max(c for _,c in cells)
            for r in range(rmin,rmax+1):
                for c in range(cmin,cmax+1):
                    out[r][c]=pat[(r-r0)%ph][(c-c0)%pw]
    return out

                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc]!=8:
